purpose: Real wall-clock cost, on this machine, of (1) the committed test suite as it runs on every push, versus (2)-(3) the two mutation-testing passes from Sections 4.4-4.5, which are periodic audits rather than per-commit checks.

runs.label: Full committed test suite (16 tests, 4 modules)
Section 4.5 systematic sweep (30 candidate mutants, 23 applicable)

note: The committed suite (16 tests) is what actually runs on every push in the GitHub Actions workflow (Section 3.3); the two mutation passes are one-off validation experiments (Sections 4.4-4.5), not part of the per-commit CI loop, which is why their cost is reported separately rather than added to the per-commit figure.
